lead: A single daily capsule of fermented bee pollen — nature's 'bee bread' — paired with vitamin C. A nutrient-dense wholefood traditionally used to support immunity, energy and everyday well-being.

science.title: Bee bread, the original superfood
science.text: When bees pack pollen into the hive, it ferments into 'bee bread' — a nutrient-dense wholefood that's richer and more digestible than raw pollen. Lactic-acid fermentation unlocks its vitamins, amino acids and antioxidants. We freeze-dry a concentrated 700 mg extract and add vitamin C, so one capsule delivers a daily dose of immune and well-being support.

format.title: Bee bread, in one easy capsule
format.text: No sticky granules or strong taste — we freeze-dry fermented bee pollen into a clean, odourless capsule you take once a day with water.
list: — 1 capsule daily = 700 mg bee bread extract + 48 mg vitamin C

absorb.title: Fermented, so your body can use it
absorb.lead: Raw pollen has a tough outer shell that's hard to digest. Fermentation breaks it down — so the nutrients in bee bread are far more available to your body.
